full_track.tags: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated sixteenth-note muted scratches and staccato chords. A slap bass guitar performs a busy, percussive line with frequent octaves and slides. The drum kit features a crisp snare and a tight, dry kick drum. Bright, staccato brass stabs from a trumpet and saxophone section punctuate the transitions. Male lead vocals are delivered in a smooth tenor range with rhythmic phrasing, supported by layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. A shimmering polyphonic synthesizer pad provides harmonic density during the refrain. Key of E Major. Tempo is 118 BPM.
